jen: ugh — that prettier diff came in with 7a3b2cf. Looks like version drift. @mike can we pin prettier to 2.8 in CI quickly? :thinking:

mike: pinning is a blunt lever. Faster fix might be to revert the formatting commit in packages/ui and re-run lint. Which is less blast-radius?

sara: prefer a hotfix branch and a focused revert. If we push this tag to canary QA will hit red. Suggest: hold canary, make hotfix branch v2.14.0-hotfix, apply formatting revert, run full pipeline.

alex: agree with hold. @deploy-bot please pause canary deploy.

deploy-bot: Canary automatically paused by policy: `blocking-lint`. Action taken: cancel downstream deploys. Reason: lint failure on staging build.

emma: I'll open a tiny PR to revert the whitespace change and add a .prettierrc to avoid drift. PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4721 — short, single-file change.

ci-bot: Re-run requested by emma — queued.

alex: nice — proceeding to create a hotfix tag and push canary. New tag: v2.14.0+hotfix-1 (sha: 7a3b2cf -> 7a3b2cf-hotfix1). Watch perf & errors after canary.

jen: noted for release notes: include small formatting hotfix in changelog and call out lint-blocked canary hold.

mike: good call holding canary. If anything flares, we rollback to v2.13.9 and notify infra. :thumbsup:

emma: thanks all — PR merged and pipeline green.
